audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows contradicted their own why-text. The chart read Jax at level 1 while whys[0] says 'he owns the level-1 opener — just farm'; Sion at 3 and 4-5 while whys[2] and whys[3] describe your grind window; Jax at 6 while whys[4] calls it a coinflip; Sion at first item while whys[5] says 'force the all-in now'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Sion/Skill/Jax/Jax/Skill/Jax/Sion at 50.08% over 1210 games — Sion's level 1, your 3 through first item, his late game. The prose already argued exactly that shape.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Sion / Skill / Jax / Jax / Skill / Jax / Sion in both layers, ratings realigned to 3, 5, 7, 7, 5, 7, 3.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly placed: his level 1, your level 3 all-in, your level 6 against the Soul Furnace shield window (15/14/13/12/11s), and his two-item tank reclaim. Your ultimate is 110/100/90s, so the level-6 window is a once-per-two-minutes commitment, not a standing state.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interaction lines were vague — 'Charged = knockup. Sidestep it' — and Roar of the Slayer's armor reduction was mentioned only in wants.foe, never in the interaction or cooldown sections where the reader looks.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks only. Decimating Smash's knockup, Soul Furnace's AoE detonation and Roar of the Slayer's shockwave all land straight through it, so E's value here is purely the recast stun. Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s and only knocks up on a long charge — a short-charge release is safe to walk through. Roar of the Slayer is 12/11/10/9/8s at 800 range and reduces your armor, which is why his charged Q hits harder than the tooltip suggests; it also knocks a minion back through you if it hits the wave first.
audit.corrected: report[5].t now states what Counter Strike does and does not blank; breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d carry the real Decimating Smash and Roar of the Slayer numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimating Smash was tracked as 'the' cooldown with no number and no second entry.
audit.why: Decimating Smash 10s and Roar of the Slayer 12s at rank 1 are both long enough that a spent pair is a genuine all-in window against a champion with zero mobility.

notes: Left in place, unverified: the page states in early, mid, spikes[1] and wants.you[0] that your Counter Strike recast stun 'interrupts his next Q charge'. Riot's Decimating Smash text does not describe the charge as a channel and the kit carries no channel flag, so I could not confirm the interrupt from the data available and did not edit those lines. suspectNames entries ('Soul Furnace's', 'Your Counter Strike') are false positives.
